exposure: Mode of delivery (spontaneous vaginal delivery vs. cesarean section)
cohort: 1057 women from the Ibadan Pregnancy Cohort Study (IbPCS)
finding: Prolonged postpartum length of hospital stay was associated with high income, frequent antenatal care visits, and antenatal admission for spontaneous vaginal deliveries, and with advanced maternal age and hypertensive disease in pregnancy for cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: Prolonged postpartum length of hospital stay was common in both spontaneous vaginal deliveries (32.1%) and cesarean deliveries (31.5%).
